# Milestone-4 synthetic decoder stack fixture

Generated by `tileplan stack-reference --out ...` with seed 37. The model
has three decoder blocks, hidden width 32, four query heads, two KV heads,
head width 8, feed-forward width 64, context capacity 6, vocabulary size 48,
and a tied token embedding/output projection. The fixture weights, activations,
and cache values are float32; TilePlan can round and pack those same weights
as BF16 for runtime tests. RoPE and RMSNorm semantics match the one-block
fixture in `decoder_m1`.

`model.json` freezes the specification. `weights.npz` has the embedding,
final norm, and nine named weights per layer. `reference_cases.npz` has five
token IDs, their logits, and final per-layer K/V caches from the PyTorch
one-token reference. Tests also compare each incremental token against full
causal-prefix recomputation.
